name: Procedural dungeon floors
oneLiner: A turn-based dungeon crawl on seeded floors: rooms placed at random, joined by a minimum spanning tree of corridors plus a few loops, doors and arches, autotiled walls and floors (faces, caps, edges, inner and outer corners), torches, decor per room type, chests, loose items and monsters placed by a per-room budget, stairs down in the room farthest from the start and a boss throne on the last floor. The hero steps in 8 directions without cutting corners, bumps monsters to fight, bumps doors and chests to open them; then every awake monster acts. Field of view by shadowcasting with a lantern and torch light, explored cells remembered, unknown cells black, a minimap and a full map. Seeded and frame-stepped (same seed = same run at any view size), with a bot that plays through the same rules.
fits: roguelikes and roguelites with turn-based exploration
dungeon levels inside an RPG or an adventure game
short mobile dungeon dives (tap to walk)
notFor: hand-made levels where every room is designed (use your own map and only the fog and turn ideas)
real-time action combat (the rules are turn-based; use A-05 sword combat or A-11 horde survival)

needs: a seed per run and a fixed 60 Hz update step (turns are input-driven; animation runs on the step)
key or tap input routed to the dungeon while it runs (8 directions, wait, tonic, map), and held direction keys
a canvas 2D context and a logical view rect, ideally an integer number of device px per art px
optional: room types, monsters and items as data
a place to go when the run is won or lost
provides: the floors: rooms, MST + loop corridors, doors, walls, stairs, room types, decor, torches, chests, items, monster budgets, boss throne
the rules: 8-way steps without corner cutting, bump attacks, doors, chests, fountains, tonics, XP and levels, monster wake / chase / erratic AI, speed 2 and 0.5
sight: shadowcasting, lit cells only, explored memory, fog

the screen: three-quarter pixel tiles, hero with walk frames and a sword (ready, wind-up, strike), combat numbers pinned to the defender's cell (damage, crit, miss, heal), hopping / flying / gliding monsters facing the hero, light grid with torches, HUD, minimap, boss bar, message log, floor banner, full map
hit site onHit on the impact frame (read-only), onEvent (floorStart, turn, move, wake, door, chest, pickup, potion, heal, fountain, death, levelUp, descend, end), onEnd(result, info)
a bot that explores, fights, loots and descends through the same rules
anchors (hero and monsters, live), unit rects, UI rects, field rect, actors() text state

params.label: Share of doorways with a door
Combat numbers (off when an addon draws its own)

assets: module/dungeon-floors.js (global GameDNA_DungeonFloors, no dependencies; API in module/README.md). Everything is drawn in code at 16 px tiles: flagstone, tile, brick, moss and throne floors, brick wall faces and caps with autotiled rims and corners, doors, arches, stairs, torches, a fountain, 11 decor kinds, chests, 5 item looks, the hooded hero (4 facings, 4-frame walk), six monster looks (slime, ember slime with a flame crown, bat, sporeling, wisp, the Hollow Crown), a throne, effects, the light grid, HUD, minimap and the 8 px pixel font. No external files.
